name: @abheet19/zeno-mesh
description: Zeno Mesh — the Windows-side E2EE protocol core that pairs a phone to the PC over a short code and converges a small amount of state (approvals waiting, receipts, backlog) end-to-end encrypted. Proven against a simulated second device; zero npm runtime deps, node:crypto only.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
